players.product: Inference-first GPU-as-a-Service cloud on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs deployed in colocation sites; NVIDIA Cloud Partner

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results release, recent corporate developments: QumulusAI signed more than $120 million in new customer agreements, including a three-year agreement valued at more than $71 million, and signed a GPU-as-a-Service agreement with DRW, a diversified trading firm (customer DRW).

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results release: QumulusAI purchased 1,632 NVIDIA Blackwell B300 GPUs to meet accelerating customer demand.

CFO Scott Krosnowski: customers are also committing and paying ahead of delivery - deferred revenue rose $30.5 million in the first half, contributing to $22.3 million of operating cash flow.
